blockers.exact_ask: Select the deployment host, then have its authorized operator run deploy/run_target_host_drills.sh against the pinned sandbox image and return the sanitized pass/fail summary plus image digest.

Select the public hostname and target host; install the Nginx template with real certificate paths, configure production auth/CORS in the protected service environment, run nginx -t and the target smoke script, and record sanitized evidence.

Assign the backup alert receiver and its owner, place its HTTPS webhook in the host secret manager, run one scheduled freshness-alert drill, and record the receiver's delivery confirmation without recording the URL.

Name the recovery operator and approve a maintenance window; restore a selected production backup into a new isolated directory, verify task/workspace integrity, and record the archive reference and outcome.
Assign a keyboard and screen-reader reviewer and supported browser/assistive-technology pair; complete the release checklist and record findings and retest evidence.
Choose the target host and approve a workload profile (concurrency, ramp, duration, and latency/error thresholds); run the load drill and record host resource and API results.
Name the primary operator, backup operator, and security/escalation contact, with their incident-response path and change-window owner.

Obtain the data owner's written approval for sending repository/report data to the configured Gemini service, including the applicable data handling and retention terms; record only the approval reference.
Assign an SLO owner and have the service owner accept the proposed availability, pipeline completion, queue latency, recovery point, and recovery time objectives or supply revised thresholds.
